runtime_notes: FastAgent support is disabled when mcp_agent is unavailable.

No mcp_server/fastagent.config.yaml is checked in at the pinned SHA. FastAgentIntegration.ensure_narrative_servers() can synthesize one at runtime, but whether the already-created FastAgent instance reloads that generated configuration is framework/runtime dependent.
FastAgent-backed helper sessions additionally require a live Ollama or LM Studio backend.

authority_facts.fact: The source declares per-agent MCP server lists and a runtime path that generates all four narrative server aliases as local stdio invocations of the same mcp_server/server.py implementation.

That shared MCP implementation exposes a broad mixed read/write surface including project/pattern/character creation, story writes, agent-script creation, agent-script deletion, and nested FastAgent session operations.
Because the checked-in runtime config is absent, the declared server relationships are configuration-dependent rather than proven live authority at the pinned source state.

findings.claim: If the generated FastAgent MCP configuration is loaded, agents that appear to bind narrow narrative server aliases actually reach the same broad MCP implementation, including persistent project/script mutation tools, with no source-visible per-action approval boundary.
evidence: mcp_server/components/fast_agent_integration.py: ensure_narrative_servers maps each alias to python mcp_server/server.py --transport stdio
mcp_server/server.py: shared server exports create/write tools plus create_agent_script and other FastAgent tools
mcp_server/fastagent_integration/fastagent_tools.py: create_script persists JSON definitions and delete_script unlinks them

controls: No public HTTP ingress was proven in the reviewed FastAgent integration.
The absence of a checked-in active fastagent.config.yaml prevents treating the declared MCP bindings as unconditionally live.

authority_facts.fact: The model is bound to guest retrieval, DuckDuckGo search, dummy weather and Hugging Face model-stat tools.
The network-capable tools use provider-mediated DuckDuckGo/Hugging Face services; the model selects search terms/authors rather than arbitrary URL/host destinations.
No state-changing, file-write, database-write or process-execution tool was found in the reviewed effective tool list.

controls: This is a precision-control case: provider-mediated search/read authority should not be conflated with arbitrary model-selected network destination authority.
No active untrusted application ingress was found in the reviewed source.

runtime_notes: The application requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY and local Python dependencies.
Both local MCP servers are started and initialized, but the code does not expose the filesystem tool catalogue to the LLM for model selection.

authority_facts.fact: CLI input controls presentation topic/content passed to the LLM.
The application explicitly calls only PPT MCP create_presentation, add_slide and save_presentation with a constant output filename output.pptx.

A second connected filesystem MCP server exposes create/write/append/modify/delete file and recursive directory deletion tools, but agent_ppt.py only lists those tools and never dispatches model output to them.

controls: Connected/discovered MCP capability is not equivalent to effective agent authority; the destructive filesystem MCP must remain structurally visible but unbound for this workflow.
The presentation write target is fixed by application code rather than model-selected.

runtime_notes: The application requires OpenAI and Firebase credentials.
The public survey flow validates that a form exists/is active and enforces a conversation/rate limit, but the reviewed chat start/message routes do not require a logged-in user identity.

authority_facts.fact: The /api/chat/start route can create a survey session for an active form and returns the session_id without user authentication.
The /api/chat/message route accepts session_id plus user message, rate-limits it, then sends the message into FormChatAgent.process_message and Runner.run_sync.
Barney is bound to save_user_response, advance_to_next_question and update_session_state; these tools call save_session, which persists session responses/history/metadata to Firestore.
The system prompt requires content sensitivity/validation before saving and update_session_state requires explicit confirmation before an end action, providing source-visible application controls.

findings.claim: Public survey respondent input enters an OpenAI Agent that can persist model-directed response/session state to Firestore. The path has validation, rate limiting and an end-confirmation control, but no separate human approval boundary for ordinary persistent response writes.
evidence: app.py: /api/chat/start creates/resumes sessions for active forms without user authentication
chat_engine.py: process_message embeds user_message then Runner.run_sync(self.agent, ...)
chat_engine.py: save_user_response -> save_session -> Firestore chat_sessions document set

controls: Active-form validation and conversation/rate limiting constrain ingress.
The agent prompt requires content sensitivity and response validation before ordinary saves.
Ending a session requires a source-enforced pending confirmation flag.

runtime_notes: The agent requires an OpenAI provider configuration plus duckduckgo_search and requests dependencies.

authority_facts.fact: The agent is bound to query classification, ticker resolution, initial discovery and deep-dive search tools.
DuckDuckGo search is provider-mediated, but deep_dive_search takes returned result URLs and fetch_page_content performs requests.get(url) without a destination allowlist.
The model controls the base query/research angle that influences which search-result URLs are fetched, but it does not receive a direct arbitrary-URL tool parameter.
No state-changing, filesystem-write or process-execution tool was found.

findings.claim: Model-selected research queries can cause the application to fetch dynamic URLs returned by DuckDuckGo with requests.get and no source-visible destination allowlist. This is broader than a fixed provider API, but weaker than direct model-controlled arbitrary URL authority.
evidence: agent.py: deep_dive_search(base_query, angle) constructs a model-influenced DuckDuckGo query
agent.py: top search result href values are passed to fetch_page_content

controls: The model does not directly choose an arbitrary URL argument; destination choice is mediated by DuckDuckGo search results.
The reviewed effective authority is read-only network research.
